recipe.visualDefinition: A surrealist composition featuring a central musician figure integrated into a dreamlike landscape of clouds and cityscapes, framed by a continuous glowing neon-like orange border that doubles as a map outline.
coreVisualRelationships: The musician's body dissolves into a cloudy sky background.
The oversized guitar neck creates a strong diagonal leading line.
A thin orange neon stroke defines the outer boundary and interacts with the lettering.
Warm skin tones and orange accents contrast against cool blue clouds and denim.
coreInvariants: Airbrushed cloud textures throughout the figure
Monolinear script lettering integrated into the border

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central male figure in a seated pose, scaled to fill the vertical center, with a large guitar neck dominating the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The musician's face with orange-tinted sunglasses, positioned in the upper center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, follows the red scarf down to the guitar, travels along the guitar neck to the right, then circles back via the neon border.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense and textured; negative space is filled with painterly clouds and distant city silhouettes.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blues and muted grays in the clouds and denim.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange used for the border, sunglasses, and lettering.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Saturated red in the scarf and warm flesh tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark, textured clothing and the bright, glowing neon outlines.

letterConstructionRules: Integrated into the frame's border line
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters are oversized and stylized with fluid loops
The 'y' descenders merge into the frame's boundary
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single monolinear script used for all text elements to maintain a unified 'neon tube' look.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the glowing tube aesthetic of the original lettering.
Captures the era-specific organic flow of the typography.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a surrealist airbrushed illustration of a man with a beard and orange sunglasses playing a blue electric guitar. His body and the background should be composed of swirling blue and white clouds with a faint city skyline at the bottom. Use a 1970s painterly style.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thin, continuous orange neon-like line that frames the entire image in an irregular shape. Incorporate monolinear cursive script text into the top left and bottom right sections of this line so the letters appear to be part of the same glowing wire.

verificationChecks: Is the orange border a single continuous stroke?
Does the figure blend into the cloud background via airbrushing?
Is the guitar positioned at a sharp diagonal?
Is the lettering monolinear and connected to the frame?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the background city silhouette
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the musician

mustAchieve: Surreal integration of figure and sky

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the orange line does not break except for stylistic gaps.
Check that the clouds have a grainy, vintage paper texture.
Verify the sunglasses have a distinct orange-to-yellow gradient.
Confirm the guitar strings are visible but fine.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Surrealist Airbrush Figure] + [Cloudscape Double Exposure] + [Continuous Neon Monoline Frame] + [Integrated Cursive Script].
